text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired
Service: redwood-inference-runtime
Incident: PD-78421
Severity: high
Trigger: sudden surge in 500s (5xx) and model_shard_unavailable errors across eu-west-1 – error rate > 12% sustained for 4m
Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-78421

incident-bot: Primary on-call (alice) notified at 11:05:12 UTC. No acknowledge after 4m -> escalating to secondary: bob

bob: ack. I'm on it. Pulling logs and recent deploys, ping if you have quick insights.

bob: Running quick checks:
```
# check recent deploys
redwoodctl deploy list --service redwood-inference-runtime --last 10
# check for errors
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=redwood-runtime --since=10m | grep ERROR | tail -n 200
```

carla: FYI, we had a model rollout earlier at 11:02 UTC (rev 61 -> 62). Could be related. If it's a model sharding failure we may need an immediate rollback.

bob: Observability snapshots: timing aligns with deploy 62. Error class: model_shard_unavailable and downstream 503s to llm-worker. CPU on shard nodes spikes then OOMs on one pod.

bob: Plan: 1) pause traffic to new revision 62 via router weight 2) kick a rollback to 61 3) if pods stay unhealthy, scale infer-pool +1 temporarily

carla: Agreed. I'll prepare rollback cmd. If rollback won't take traffic fast enough, we should scale. Call a bridge if this crosses 10m.

incident-bot: Manager escalation: incident unacknowledged by primary > 5m earlier. Manager (dan) paged due to customer impact threshold and duration.

dan: ack (manager). Joining. Please open a bridge and list affected orgs/customers. I want a short customer impact summary in the thread.

bob: Bridge: https://zoom.example/rdw-incident-78421
Executing pause and rollback now:
```
# pause routing to rev 62
redwoodctl traffic set-weight --service redwood-inference-runtime --rev 62 --weight 0
# rollback to 61
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service redwood-inference-runtime --to-revision 61 --reason "rev62 correlated with increased 5xx"
# job id: rb-61-20260315
```

bob: Rollback job started. Observability: new logs show pods for rev62 terminating; rev61 pods coming back to steady-state. Error rate trending down.

pagerduty-bot: PD update: PD-78421 acknowledged by bob at 11:11:38 UTC. Escalation to manager (dan) recorded. Note appended: \"rollback rb-61-20260315 initiated\"

alice: sorry — phone on DND, didn't see the mobile push. I'll fix PD mobile settings and confirm secondary contact list.

carla: Quick customer impact (initial): global error rate peaked at 12.3% between 11:06-11:11 UTC. Most orgs saw little to no effect, but 3 high-QPS customers in eu-west-1 experienced 20-30% failed requests for ~5 minutes. No data loss, requests retried by clients.

bob: After rollback and scaling +1, latency back to baseline and 5xx down to ~0.8% across region. Validating traces and service dashboards for next 20m.

incident-bot: PD update: status changed Investigating -> Mitigating

dan: Good work. Please capture the exact deploy id and timing in the ticket and attach the traces for the three impacted customers. Also let's add action items: PD contact verification, pre-deploy health gate for model rollouts, and an infra runbook for quick rollback vs scale decision tree.

carla: I'll own the deploy gate proposal (owner: carla). Drafting the proposal and will include an auto-rollback if 5xx > 2% over a 2m rolling window during rollout.

alice: I'll validate mobile push delivery and set DND overrides for PD for primary on-call (owner: alice).

bob: Adding logs and rollback job rb-61-20260315 to PD ticket PD-78421. Also saved command output and kubectl traces.

pagerduty-bot: PD update: PD-78421 resolved by bob at 11:18:11 UTC. Postmortem requested.

dan: Closing notes: monitor the customer retries for the next hour and coordinate comms if any customers report persistent issues. Schedule a 1hr postmortem in next 72 hours.

incident-bot: Reactions summary: :white_check_mark: mitigated, :memo: postmortem requested, :phone: primary missed page — follow-up assigned.

carla: Drafting RCA now; will include timeline, root cause hypothesis (rev62 sharding misconfiguration), remediation plan, and owners. Please drop any additional logs into PD-78421.

bob: Will follow up with exact pod OOM logs and metric snapshots.

alice: filing PD contact updates and will run mobile push tests.

dan: Thanks team. Good follow-through. We'll run the postmortem and close the loop.
